api.name: deployVirtualMachine
api.description: Creates and automatically starts  an Instance based on a service offering, disk offering, and Template.

params.name: keypair
params.description: name of the ssh key pair used to login to the virtual machine

params.name: dhcpoptionsnetworklist
params.description: DHCP options which are passed to the VM on start up Example: dhcpoptionsnetworklist[0].dhcp:114=url&dhcpoptionsetworklist[0].networkid=networkid&dhcpoptionsetworklist[0].dhcp:66=www.test.com

params.name: account
params.description: an optional account for the virtual machine. Must be used with domainId.

params.name: startvm
params.description: true if start vm after creating; defaulted to true if not specified

params.name: affinitygroupids
params.description: comma separated list of affinity groups id that are going to be applied to the virtual machine. Mutually exclusive with affinitygroupnames parameter

params.name: userdata
params.description: an optional binary data that can be sent to the virtual machine upon a successful deployment. This binary data must be base64 encoded before adding it to the request. Using HTTP GET (via querystring), you can send up to 4KB of data after base64 encoding. Using HTTP POST (via POST body), you can send up to 1MB of data after base64 encoding. You also need to change vm.userdata.max.length value

params.name: projectid
params.description: Deploy vm for the project

params.name: userdataid
params.description: the ID of the Userdata

params.name: macaddress
params.description: the mac address for default vm's network

params.name: properties
params.description: used to specify the vApp properties.

params.name: securitygroupids
params.description: comma separated list of security groups id that going to be applied to the virtual machine. Should be passed only when vm is created from a zone with Basic Network support. Mutually exclusive with securitygroupnames parameter

params.name: iodriverpolicy
params.description: Controls specific policies on IO

params.name: blankinstance
params.description: Whether to create a blank instance without storage and network

params.name: leaseduration
params.description: Number of days instance is leased for.

params.name: displayvm
params.description: an optional field, whether to the display the vm to the end user or not.

params.name: iothreadsenabled
params.description: IOThreads are dedicated event loop threads for supported disk devices to perform block I/O requests in order to improve scalability especially on an SMP host/guest with many LUNs.

params.name: hypervisor
params.description: the hypervisor on which to deploy the virtual machine. The parameter is required and respected only when hypervisor info is not set on the ISO/Template passed to the call

params.name: bootintosetup
params.description: Boot into hardware setup or not (ignored if startVm = false, only valid for vmware)

params.name: nicmultiqueuenumber
params.description: The number of queues for multiqueue NICs.

params.name: podid
params.description: Destination Pod ID to deploy the Instance to - parameter available for root admin only

params.name: externaldetails
params.description: Details in key/value pairs using format externaldetails[i].keyname=keyvalue. Example: externaldetails[0].server.type=typevalue

params.name: templateid
params.description: The ID of the Template for the Instance

params.name: overridediskofferingid
params.description: the ID of the disk offering for the virtual machine to be used for root volume instead of the disk offering mapped in service offering.In case of virtual machine deploying from ISO, then the diskofferingid specified for root volume is ignored and uses this override disk offering id

params.name: deploymentplanner
params.description: Deployment planner to use for vm allocation. Available to ROOT admin only

params.name: bootmode
params.description: Boot Mode [Legacy] or [Secure] Applicable when Boot Type Selected is UEFI, otherwise Legacy only for BIOS. Not applicable with VMware if the template is marked as deploy-as-is, as we honour what is defined in the template.

params.name: ip6address
params.description: the ipv6 address for default vm's network

params.name: domainid
params.description: an optional domainId for the virtual machine. If the account parameter is used, domainId must also be used. If account is NOT provided then virtual machine will be assigned to the caller account and domain.

params.name: rootdisksize
params.description: Optional field to resize root disk on deploy. Value is in GB. Only applies to template-based deployments. Analogous to details[0].rootdisksize, which takes precedence over this parameter if both are provided

params.name: userdatadetails
params.description: used to specify the parameters values for the variables in userdata.

params.name: nicnetworklist
params.description: VMware only: used to specify network mapping of a vApp VMware template registered "as-is". Example nicnetworklist[0].ip=Nic-101&nicnetworklist[0].network=uuid

params.name: zoneid
params.description: availability zone for the virtual machine

params.name: displayname
params.description: an optional user generated name for the virtual machine

params.name: securitygroupnames
params.description: comma separated list of security groups names that going to be applied to the virtual machine. Should be passed only when vm is created from a zone with Basic Network support. Mutually exclusive with securitygroupids parameter

params.name: datadisksdetails
params.description: Disk offering details for creating multiple data volumes. Mutually exclusive with diskOfferingId. Example: datadisksdetails[0].diskofferingid=a2a73a84-19db-4852-8930-dfddef053341&datadisksdetails[0].size=10&datadisksdetails[0].miniops=100&datadisksdetails[0].maxiops=200&datadisksdetails[0].kmskeyid=<uuid>

params.name: nicpackedvirtqueuesenabled
params.description: Enable packed virtqueues or not.

params.name: copyimagetags
params.description: if true the image tags (if any) will be copied to the VM, default value is false

params.name: ipaddress
params.description: the ip address for default vm's network

params.name: iptonetworklist
params.description: ip to network mapping. Can't be specified with networkIds parameter. Example: iptonetworklist[0].ip=10.10.10.11&iptonetworklist[0].ipv6=fc00:1234:5678::abcd&iptonetworklist[0].networkid=uuid&iptonetworklist[0].mac=aa:bb:cc:dd:ee::ff - requests to use ip 10.10.10.11 in network id=uuid

params.name: customid
params.description: An optional field, in case you want to set a custom id to the resource. Allowed to Root Admins only

params.name: size
params.description: the arbitrary size for the DATADISK volume. Mutually exclusive with diskOfferingId

params.name: keyboard
params.description: an optional keyboard device type for the virtual machine. valid value can be one of de,de-ch,es,es-latam,fi,fr,fr-be,fr-ch,is,it,jp,nl-be,no,pt,uk,us

params.name: rootdiskkmskeyid
params.description: ID of the KMS Key to use for root disk encryption

params.name: keypairs
params.description: names of the ssh key pairs used to login to the virtual machine

params.name: name
params.description: host name for the virtual machine

params.name: networkids
params.description: list of network ids used by virtual machine. Can't be specified with ipToNetworkList parameter

params.name: datadiskofferinglist
params.description: datadisk template to disk-offering mapping; an optional parameter used to create additional data disks from datadisk templates; can't be specified with diskOfferingId parameter

params.name: hostid
params.description: destination Host ID to deploy the VM to - parameter available for root admin only

params.name: dynamicscalingenabled
params.description: true if virtual machine needs to be dynamically scalable

params.name: group
params.description: an optional group for the virtual machine

params.name: boottype
params.description: Guest VM Boot option either custom[UEFI] or default boot [BIOS]. Not applicable with VMware if the template is marked as deploy-as-is, as we honour what is defined in the template.

params.name: leaseexpiryaction
params.description: Lease expiry action, valid values are STOP and DESTROY

params.name: affinitygroupnames
params.description: comma separated list of affinity groups names that are going to be applied to the virtual machine.Mutually exclusive with affinitygroupids parameter

params.name: extraconfig
params.description: an optional URL encoded string that can be passed to the virtual machine upon successful deployment

params.name: diskofferingid
params.description: the ID of the disk offering for the virtual machine. If the template is of ISO format, the diskOfferingId is for the root disk volume. Otherwise this parameter is used to indicate the offering for the data disk volume. If the templateId parameter passed is from a Template object, the diskOfferingId refers to a DATA Disk Volume created. If the templateId parameter passed is from an ISO object, the diskOfferingId refers to a ROOT Disk Volume created.

params.name: password
params.description: The password of the virtual machine. If null, a random password will be generated for the VM.

params.name: details
params.description: used to specify the custom parameters. 'extraconfig' is not allowed to be passed in details

params.name: clusterid
params.description: Destination Cluster ID to deploy the Instance to - parameter available for root admin only

params.name: serviceofferingid
params.description: The ID of the Service offering for the Instance
